model.name: RbDiffEditor.applyFold
model.note: R30.51 (architect setHiddenAreas design, design-folding.md). camelCase for [impl]. applyFold(): projects the SHARED _collapsedGaps:Set<gapIdx> to each editor's line-ranges -> editor.setHiddenAreas() x3 (one state -> 3 projections; NO FoldingController listener / no cross-editor event mirror). toggleGap(idx) affordance mutates the set -> applyFold. Post-apply: renderInterPaneGutters + renderConnectorRibbons (spline reflows via getTopForLineNumber, R30.16). Realizes UC merge.foldSyncAcrossPanes.
